action: Toggle One-Shot Playback Mode
context: Sample selected (GATE LED will pulse)
goal: Let a long sample play all the way through without retriggering in a pattern, or prevent accidental double-triggers when finger drumming short drums.

action: Latch pad playback without holding it down
context: Sample Mode
goal: Keep a gated or looping sample playing hands-free without holding your finger on the pad.

action: Stop all currently playing samples (Panic)
context: Or press EXIT 4 times rapidly
goal: Immediately silence long tail samples, loops, or stuck audio.

action: Pause / resume playing audio or pattern
context: Works in Sample Playback, Pattern Play, and TR-REC
goal: Freeze playback in place and resume from the exact same spot instead of restarting from bar 1.

action: Switch between primary (A–E) and alternate (F–J) bank
context: Press the active Bank button a second time
goal: Jump between Bank A and Bank F (or B and G, etc.) with one button press.

action: Toggle Ping-Pong Looping
context: Sample selected with LOOP enabled
goal: Loop a sample forward then backward seamlessly to avoid harsh loop clicks on sustained textures.

action: Set Roll repeat rate / time division
context: Hold ROLL + PAD to trigger roll at chosen division
goal: Change note repeat speed between 1/4, 1/8, 1/16, 1/32, or triplets for hi-hat rolls and fills.

action: View pad info and rename sample
context: Select pad first, hold/press REMAIN, then scroll down with VALUE
goal: Inspect sample details or give a pad a custom readable name on the OLED display.

action: Recall last 40 seconds of audio (Skip Back Sampling)
context: When MARK button is glowing after playing audio
goal: Capture a happy accident or jam you just played without having pressed REC beforehand.
steps: Press glowing MARK button to load the last 40s buffer
Press SUB PAD to preview; use CTRL 1 (Start) & CTRL 3 (End) to trim
Press REC → select destination PAD → press REC to save

action: Quick-combine / bounce multiple pads together
context: Select pads to merge (Note: does not copy all individual parameters)
goal: Quickly layer a kick and snare or chord pads onto a single new pad.

action: Latch Pad Mute Mode on (exit with EXIT or SHIFT + REVERSE)
context: During Pattern Playback (Pads turn white when muted)
goal: Drop drum or melodic parts in and out live during a pattern—or press REC inside Pad Mute Mode to record mute automation.

action: Momentary Pad Mute screen
context: Hold both SHIFT + REVERSE, tap pads to mute/unmute, release to return
goal: Quickly mute or unmute a sample in a running pattern without staying locked in Pad Mute Mode.

action: Copy specific sample(s) from one pattern to another
context: While in Pattern Copy screen, press REMAIN to filter pads
goal: Create arrangement variations (e.g., copy just the kick and bass into an empty pattern).
steps: In PATTERN SELECT, press COPY and select source pattern PAD
Press REMAIN, then tap the specific sample PADs you want to include
Press REMAIN again, select destination empty pattern PAD, and press COPY / VALUE

action: Delete all notes of a specific sample from a pattern
context: In PATTERN EDIT mode (Pads with notes light up blue)
goal: Wipe a single bad drum part or bassline from a pattern without erasing the rest of the loop.

action: Real-time Erase Mode while pattern is looping
context: While in Pattern Record (press DEL again to return to record)
goal: Erase only specific hits of a sound as the loop passes over them.

action: Bounce / convert pattern (or stems) directly to a sample pad
context: In PATTERN EDIT or PATTERN COPY menu
goal: Render a pattern—or individual stems using REMAIN—into an audio sample faster than real-time resampling.
steps: In PATTERN EDIT (or PATTERN SELECT), press COPY and choose the pattern to bounce
Optional: Press REMAIN and select specific pads if you only want stems
Press PATTERN SELECT to switch destination from Pattern to Sample Bank
Choose an empty destination PAD and press COPY (or push VALUE) to bounce

action: Toggle Rehearsal Mode during pattern recording
context: While already recording a pattern (REC LED blinks)
goal: Practice playing a part over the looping pattern without committing notes until you press REC again.

action: Undo last pattern recording step (up to 16 levels)
context: While recording or overdubbing a pattern
goal: Revert a bad take immediately (remaining undo steps show on the left of the OLED).

action: Enter Microscope Mode for step/substep note editing
context: In PATTERN EDIT (or within TR-REC substeps)
goal: Inspect and nudge individual note events, micro-timing, or substep triggers on a specific pad.

action: Enter TR-REC step sequencer mode
context: On Pattern Record Setting screen, press REMAIN to switch from Real-Time to TR-REC
goal: Program drum steps on the 16-pad grid like a classic Roland TR-808/909.
steps: Press PATTERN SELECT → REC → select empty PAD
Press REMAIN to switch to TR-REC (or press REC then REMAIN)
Hold SUB PAD + press a PAD to select sound without placing a step
Use VALUE encoder to switch bars; CTRL 1 for Substep type; CTRL 3 for Velocity

action: Record parameter motion (Substep, Velocity, Pitch) in TR-REC
context: While TR-REC pattern is running
goal: Automate pitch slides, velocity ramps, or ratchets per step in real time.

action: Start Effects Motion Recording (FX Automation) in a pattern
context: While recording a pattern (START/END toggles Motion On/Off; SHIFT + MARK deletes motion)
goal: Automate filter sweeps, delay throws, or effect toggles directly inside a pattern loop.

action: Quantize a pattern after recording
context: In PATTERN EDIT → select pattern PAD → press RECORD SETTING or push VALUE
goal: Tighten timing (Grid via CTRL 2, Strength % via CTRL 3) non-destructively or save to a pad.

action: Create and play a Pattern Chain (Song Mode)
context: In PATTERN SELECT, hold HOLD (pads flash green) + press PAD to choose Chain Slot 1–16
goal: Sequence patterns in order to build or resample a complete song arrangement.
steps: In PATTERN SELECT, hold HOLD + press a PAD to select one of 16 Chain Slots
Tap pattern PADs in the order you want them to play
Press REMAIN to set repeat count for steps; press SUB PAD to play chain
To resample a chain: PATTERN SELECT → RESAMPLE → destination PAD → HOLD + Chain PAD → SUB PAD

action: Delete a pattern (or DEL + EXIT to delete all patterns in a bank)
context: In PATTERN SELECT mode
goal: Clear a single pattern pad or wipe an entire bank of patterns at once.

action: Lock Loop Point while adjusting Start Point
context: On START/END sample edit screen
goal: Prevent the Loop point from shifting when you move the Start point past it.

action: Play only the last 4 seconds of a sample
context: On START/END sample edit screen
goal: Quickly audition and fine-tune the End point of a long sample without listening from the very beginning.

action: Toggle Snap to Zero-Crossing
context: On START/END or CHOP edit screen
goal: Eliminate clicks and pops at sample start/end/chop points by snapping markers to zero amplitude.

action: Open Sample Chop Menu (Manual, Auto Mark, Assign to Pads)
context: Sample selected
goal: Slice a breakbeat or melodic sample into up to 16 playable pad slices.
steps: Manual Lazy Chop: Press PAD to play, tap other PADs (or MARK) as it plays to drop markers
Fine-tune markers: CTRL 3 selects mark, CTRL 2 moves selected mark, CTRL 1 places new mark
Auto Chop: Push VALUE → AUTO MARK → CTRL 2 chooses TIME DIVISION, LEVEL, or TRANSIENT
Assign to Pads: Push VALUE → ASSIGN TO PAD → press MARK to auto-select pads → push VALUE twice

action: Truncate sample (permanently delete audio outside Start/End)
context: On START/END screen, push VALUE encoder to open menu
goal: Free up memory and normalize/chop accurately by trimming unused audio before Start and after End.

action: Access Groove / Humanization settings for sample
context: On PITCH/SPEED screen, press ROLL
goal: Add subtle timing/pitch humanization or groove variance to static samples.

action: Adjust Pitch, Speed, Volume, or Envelope for ALL pads in current Bank
context: On PITCH/SPEED or ENVELOPE (SHIFT + PITCH/SPEED) screen
goal: Batch-edit volume, tuning, or release tails across all 16 pads in the current bank simultaneously.

action: Adjust Pitch, Speed, Volume, Gate, or Loop for pads in same Mute Group
context: On PITCH/SPEED screen (Mute Group pads will flash)
goal: Change tuning, speed, or volume across all chopped slices of a sample without affecting drums in the same bank.

action: Switch between VINYL Mode and VARISPEED (Backing / Ensemble)
context: On PITCH/SPEED screen
goal: Choose classic Vinyl repitching (pitch & speed linked) or independent pitch/time-stretch (Backing for drums, Ensemble for chords/bass).

action: Adjust Sample Panning or force Stereo sample to MONO (L/R)
context: On PITCH/SPEED screen
goal: Pan individual drums left/right or collapse a stereo breakbeat/bass sample to mono.

action: Open Amplitude Envelope (Attack, Hold, Release) screen
context: CTRL 1 = Attack, CTRL 2 = Hold, CTRL 3 = Release
goal: Fade in a sample (Attack) or add a smooth fade-out tail (Release) so chops don't cut off abruptly.

action: Auto-detect or manually set fine decimal BPM (MANU-F)
context: On PITCH/SPEED screen (Turn VALUE to select MANU or MANU-F for decimals)
goal: Set exact loop tempo or scan BPM within a target range so half/double-time loops sync properly.

action: Flip / swap the effects assigned to Bus 1 and Bus 2
context: Anytime
goal: Instantly reverse the serial routing order of your Bus 1 and Bus 2 effects (e.g., Filter into Delay vs. Delay into Filter).

action: Toggle Master Bus 3 + Bus 4 effects on/off
context: Anytime
goal: Bypass or engage your master chain effects (like 303 Vinyl Sim + Compressor on Bus 3/4) for instant A/B comparison.

action: Mute Bus (silence audio routed to Bus 1/2 while keeping tails/dry pads)
context: Dry pads (lit white) continue playing
goal: Drop out the main beat routed through Bus 1/2 while letting reverb/delay tails ring out or keeping a dry vocal/drum playing.

action: Save current MFX / Faceplate FX parameters as default
context: While on the effect parameter screen
goal: Make your favorite Filter, Vinyl Sim, or Isolator knob settings persist even after turning the SP-404MKII off.

action: Lock the FX parameter screen on the OLED display
context: While in an effect menu, press REMAIN + the FX button
goal: Stop the effect parameter screen from auto-closing after a few seconds while you tweak knobs.

action: Inspect or pre-tweak an effect screen without turning the effect on
context: Press REMAIN first, then the FX button
goal: Check or preset knob parameters before dropping the effect into a live performance.

action: Momentarily 'Grab' / punch-in an effect only while held
context: Hold VALUE encoder down, press FX button(s), release to disengage
goal: Punch in a quick DJFX Looper stutter, Isolator cut, or Delay throw for one beat and snap right back.

action: Jump directly to MFX Page 2 (17–32) or Page 3 / SFX (33+)
context: Hold MFX + DJFX LOOPER (Page 2) or ISOLATOR (Page 3), then tap PAD 1–16
goal: Select any of the 40+ MFX (including Cloud Delay, SFX Reverb, Backspin) instantly using the 16 pads without scrolling.

action: Access the 2nd page of 3 additional FX parameters
context: When a down-arrow icon appears on the FX screen
goal: Adjust the bottom row of effect parameters (4–6) using CTRL 1–3 knobs.

action: Send Pad (or entire Bank) to Bus 1, Bus 2, or Dry (White)
context: Select BUS 1 or BUS 2 first with BUS FX, then hold REMAIN + tap PAD (or BANK)
goal: Route drums to Bus 1 (Compressor) and samples to Bus 2 (Filter), or exclude a pad from effects completely (White LED).

action: Open Input Settings (Ext In vs. Mix routing, Input BPM, Input FX)
context: CTRL 2 switches between EXT IN (external only) and MIX (internal + external)
goal: Record only your external synth/phone/mic without capturing internal playing pads, or add Input FX.

action: Toggle Gate ON/OFF for all 16 pads in current Bank
context: Sample Mode
goal: Turn off Gate for an entire bank of drum hits or chops at once instead of tapping Gate 16 times.

action: Adjust overall Volume for an entire Bank
context: Hold SHIFT and press the Bank button (A/F–E/J)
goal: Balance a loud drum bank against a quiet sample bank without editing individual pads or changing master VOLUME.

action: Delete all samples (or patterns) in an entire Bank
context: Press DEL + EXIT, select the Bank (or PAD), then press DEL to confirm
goal: Wipe a whole bank clean in seconds instead of deleting 16 pads one by one.

action: Copy an entire Bank to another Bank or another Project
context: Use CTRL 3 to choose target Project; COPY > CTRL 3 also copies single pads across Projects
goal: Move your favorite drum kit bank or pattern bank into a brand new project.

action: Protect / lock current Bank from accidental edits or deletion
context: Sample Mode
goal: Lock finished banks so you can't accidentally overwrite or delete a sample live.

action: Open Project Select / Manager (16 Projects on PAD 1–16)
context: Press PAD to load, COPY to duplicate project, DEL to delete project
goal: Switch between your 16 projects on the SD card or duplicate a project as a backup before experimenting.

action: Toggle Fixed Velocity Mode (Full Level)
context: SHIFT + PAD 1 (FIXED VEL)
goal: Trigger samples at maximum 127 volume regardless of how softly or hard you hit the pads.

action: Enter 16 Velocity Mode for selected sample
context: PAD 13 = quietest, PAD 4 = loudest
goal: Play subtle ghost notes and dynamic hi-hat/snare rolls across 16 progressive volume levels.

action: Toggle Cue Mode (audition pads in headphones only)
context: Pads light up GREEN when sent to Cue
goal: Preview sounds in your headphones during a live set without sending them to the main Line Out.

action: Enter Chromatic / Scale Mode (Mono, Legato, Poly)
context: Press REMAIN for Mono/Legato/Poly; Push VALUE to select Scale; Turn VALUE for Root note
goal: Play any sample melodically across the 16 pads—including polyphonic chords or locked musical scales—and record into patterns.
steps: Select sample PAD → press SHIFT + PAD 4
Press REMAIN to cycle MONO → LEGATO → POLY (up to 4-note chords)
Push VALUE encoder to cycle Scales (Chromatic, Major, Minor, Dorian, Phrygian, etc.)
To record into a pattern: Enter Pattern Record → press REC for Rehearsal → press SHIFT + PAD 4 → press REC to record notes

action: Exchange / swap two sample pads
context: Select first PAD → select second PAD → press COPY (or push VALUE)
goal: Rearrange your drum kit layout on the 4x4 grid without needing an empty temporary pad.

action: Initialize sample parameters (Reset Pitch, Speed, Env)
context: Select PAD → press SHIFT + PAD 6 → confirm with VALUE
goal: Revert a sample back to its original un-pitched, un-trimmed factory state.

action: Configure Pad Link groups (trigger multiple pads from one hit)
context: Tap pads to link together, press EXIT when done
goal: Layer a kick + sub-bass or snare + clap so hitting one pad fires all linked pads simultaneously.

action: Assign pads to Mute Groups A–J (Choke groups)
context: 10 Mute Groups available across banks
goal: Make open hi-hats choke when closed hi-hats hit, or make melodic sample chops cut each other off cleanly.

action: Toggle Metronome On/Off
context: Adjust click volume in Utility > Click
goal: Turn the click track on or off while recording or practicing patterns.

action: Cycle Recording Count-In (1 Meas, 2 Meas, Wait, Off)
context: WAIT starts recording automatically as soon as input audio exceeds threshold
goal: Add a 1- or 2-bar count-in before pattern recording, or use WAIT for threshold-triggered sampling.

action: Open Bank Tap Tempo screen
context: Tap SUB PAD repeatedly to set tempo, or turn VALUE encoder
goal: Tap in the master/bank tempo by ear and sync all BPM-Sync enabled pads in the bank.

action: Open Input Attenuator, Noise Gate & Output Gain settings
context: Quick shortcut to Gain/Input staging parameters
goal: Prevent hot line inputs from clipping with the Attenuator or gate out background hum on the Mic/Guitar jack.

action: Open Utility Menu (System, Knob Mode, Sub Pad Mode, Backup, Factory Reset)
context: Set Knob Mode (Direct vs. Catch) or Sub Pad Mode (Retrigger vs. Skip Back)
goal: Configure system preferences, MIDI channels, SD card full backups, and Catch knob behavior.

action: Import / Export Samples & Multipads from SD Card (or Format SD)
context: Browse WAV/AIFF files on SD card to load onto pads
goal: Load drum kits from your SD card or export finished samples/patterns without a computer.

action: Open Pad Settings (Velocity Curve, Threshold, LED Colors)
context: Customize pad trigger feel and custom RGB color coding
goal: Adjust pad velocity sensitivity for your finger-drumming style or color-code pads by instrument.

action: Open EFX Settings (Bus 1/2 Routing Type A/B, Bus 3/4 Master FX, Direct FX Assign)
context: Push VALUE to toggle Type A (Serial) vs Type B (Parallel); Turn VALUE for Favorites 1–16
goal: Choose serial vs. parallel Bus 1/2 routing, set up Bus 3 & 4 master effects, or customize the 5 top Direct FX buttons.

action: Add Input FX when recording an external source
context: Press EXT SOURCE → REC → RECORD SETTING → Push VALUE encoder to configure Input FX
goal: Print built-in SP-404MKII effects (like Vinyl Sim, Compressor, or Filter) directly onto incoming external audio from USB, Line In, or Mic/Guitar.
steps: Press EXT SOURCE to monitor incoming audio, then press REC
Press RECORD SETTING and push the VALUE encoder to select and tweak Input FX
Press EXIT twice, select your destination PAD, and press REC to start recording

action: Edit Pattern BPM, Bar Length, or Duplicate / Crop Bars
context: In PATTERN EDIT: CTRL 1 = BPM, CTRL 3 = Length, Push VALUE = Duplicate or Crop
goal: Change a pattern's tempo, double/duplicate a 2-bar loop into 4 bars so you can add variations, or crop excess bars.

action: Queue the next pattern to play seamlessly after current loop finishes
context: While a pattern is already playing in PATTERN SELECT mode (pads flash purple)
goal: Transition smoothly between song sections live—tap the next pattern pad anytime and it will wait until the current bar loop completes.

action: Use the SP-404MKII as a standalone live Effects Processor for external gear
context: Connect synth/turntable/mixer to rear Line In, enable EXT SOURCE, and engage FX buttons
goal: Run external synths, drum machines, or turntables live through the SP-404MKII's Filter+Drive, DJFX Looper, and Bus 1–4 effects without recording.

action: Enter DJ Mode (Dual-Deck CH1 / CH2 Performance Mixer)
context: Press BANK B/G + C/H simultaneously; Pads 1–16 become CH1/CH2 transport controls
goal: Mix two tracks live using CH1 (left pads: BEND+/-, BPM+/-, |<<, SYNC, ▶/⏸, CUE) and CH2 (right pads).
steps: Press BANK B/G and BANK C/H at the same time to enter DJ Mode
Pads 1 & 5 = CH1 Pitch Bend +/- | Pads 2 & 6 = CH1 BPM +/- (Pads 3/7 & 4/8 for CH2)
Pad 9 = CH1 Restart (|<<) | Pad 10 = CH1 Beat Sync (Pads 11 & 12 for CH2)
Pad 13 = CH1 Play/Pause (▶/⏸) | Pad 14 = CH1 Headphone Cue (Pads 15 & 16 for CH2)
